data.rationale: The proposal matches the core flow (type venue, pick suggestion, optionally pick date, click event, set times, Update Search, Book Now) with the right parameters, but it omits the sort option and adds an amenity filter step that was only partly matched. It also describes the time controls as "Enter After / Exit Before" rather than Start/End Time dropdowns, so the exact controls are a bit loose, though the spec is still concrete enough to automate.
